name: Csesztreg (Hungary)
description: Three horizontal stripes of pale blue, white and pale blue in the ratio 1:1:1, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Csesztreg (a blue shield with a white tree, bordered in yellow) below a yellow scroll inscribed CSESZTREG.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
